question: Each of A, B, C, D, E, F, and G has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. A has an exam on Tuesday. Exactly three people have exams between A and D. F’s exam is immediately after G’s exam. Only one person has an exam between B and F. C has an exam before both B and E. E does not have an exam on Saturday or Sunday. How many people have exams after C?
solution:
Given: Each of A, B, C, D, E, F, and G has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

 
• A has an exam on Tuesday.
 
• Exactly three people have exams between A and D.
 
• F’s exam is immediately after G’s exam.
 
• Only one person has an exam between B and F.
 
• C has an exam before both B and E.
 
• E does not have an exam on Saturday or Sunday.
